name: dsh-netease-lyrics
description: Lyrics companion for DeepSeek Harness: reads the current SMTC media session (NetEase via BetterNCM + InfLink-rs, QQ Music, KuGou, or any SMTC player), matches the track against NetEase, then QQ Music, then KuGou and Migu (falling back to a local .lrc sidecar or embedded tags), and renders BOTH a hover-expandable capsule with a breathing halo and limpbus-style ambient floating lyrics. Zero runtime dependencies.
